These fees are impacted by changes in market values of the assets and by client dollars invested in and divested from the accounts."

Also EDJ-10K-2025#23 (cited in pool): "The Partnership earns revenue on clients' assets through service fees and revenue sharing... Cash solutions revenue... asset-based fees and per-account fees from the Money Market Fund... asset-based fees from trust services and investment management services."

EDJ-10K-2025#208: "Other asset-based fee revenue consists of revenue sharing, fund adviser fees, cash solutions and Trust Co. fees."
